'''Trilon, Inc.''' was a small company known to produce [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hulls and basic control systems. Their products were easily upgradeable, and were often constructed with some components made by larger companies, such as [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. Each of Trilon's products was constructed to meet the client's individual demands.

Trilon, Inc. was thought to be based on the industrial world of [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]] used this to his advantage when he assumed control of the planet prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The Trilon, Inc. computer-based design systems were used by the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] to create the [[Aggressor assault fighter/Legends|Aggressor assault fighter]], which became the base for IG-88's [[IG-2000/Legends|''IG-2000'']] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Other Trilon products included the [[M-31 airspeeder|M31-Speeder]] and the [[Mining Barque]].
